create_adam_optimizer: create an Adam optimizer with configurable learning rate, weight decay, and epsilon for a PyTorch model
create_adamw_optimizer: create an AdamW optimizer with decoupled weight decay regularization for FP16 training support
create_sgd_optimizer: create an SGD optimizer with configurable learning rate, momentum, and weight decay for a model
create_adagrad_optimizer: create an Adagrad optimizer with configurable learning rate and weight decay for a PyTorch model
extract_learning_rates: extract learning rates from all parameter groups of a PyTorch optimizer using the learning_rates function
